achievement.365.description: Kristal Bahçeleri tüm çarpıcı güzelliğiyle gördünüz ve oradaki aynı derecede etkileyici canavarlardan kurtuldunuz. Sonunda büyük bir kötülüğü keşfettiniz ve onun desteğinin farkında bile olmayan bir ölüm perisinin yardımıyla onu yok ettiniz.
achievement.365.name: Banshee'nin Feryadı
achievement.366.description: [TR] You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Tanıtım
achievement.367.description: [TR] By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: Snake Charmer
achievement.368.description: [TR] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: [TR] Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.370.description: [TR] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: [TR] Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: [TR] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: [TR] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: [TR] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: [TR] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: [TR] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: [TR] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [TR] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: [TR] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: [TR] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.380.description: [TR] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: [TR] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: [TR] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: [TR] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: [TR] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: [TR] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [TR] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: [TR] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: [TR] Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: [TR] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: Personal Nightmare
achievement.390.description: [TR] It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: [TR] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: [TR] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [TR] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [TR] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: [TR] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: [TR] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: [TR] Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: [TR] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [TR] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: [TR] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: Bearbaiting
achievement.400.description: [TR] 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: Lucky Horseshoe
achievement.401.description: [TR] By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: Swamp Beast
achievement.402.description: [TR] Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin-Off
achievement.403.description: [TR] Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Icy Glare
achievement.404.description: [TR] You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: [TR] Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: Lost Palace Raider
achievement.406.description: [TR] It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
achievement.406.name: [TR] The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: [TR] You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
achievement.408.name: Rift Warrior
achievement.410.description: [TR] You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Hat Hunter
achievement.411.description: [TR] You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Ogre Chef
achievement.412.description: [TR] You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
achievement.412.name: [TR] The Call of the Wild
achievement.413.description: [TR] You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
achievement.413.name: [TR] Ender of the End
achievement.414.description: [TR] After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
achievement.414.name: Vortex Tamer
achievement.415.description: [TR] Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
achievement.415.name: Rhino Rider
achievement.416.description: [TR] You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
achievement.416.name: Forbidden Fruit
achievement.417.description: [TR] Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
achievement.417.name: Forbidden Knowledge
achievement.418.description: [TR] You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
achievement.418.name: Treasure Hunter
achievement.419.description: [TR] You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
achievement.419.name: Reason to Celebrate
achievement.420.description: [TR] You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
achievement.420.name: Toothfairy Assistant
achievement.421.description: [TR] Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
achievement.421.name: Fairy Teasing
achievement.422.description: [TR] You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
achievement.422.name: Corruption Contained
achievement.430.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.430.name: Little Adventure
achievement.431.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.431.name: Little Big Adventure
achievement.432.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.432.name: Contender
achievement.433.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.433.name: Serious Contender
achievement.434.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.434.name: Skilled Hunter
achievement.435.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
achievement.435.name: Master Hunter
achievement.436.description: [TR] You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
achievement.436.name: Hunting Permit
achievement.437.description: [TR] The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
achievement.437.name: Over the Moon
achievement.438.description: [TR] You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.438.name: [TR] His Days are Counted
achievement.439.description: [TR] You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.439.name: Duked It Out
achievement.440.description: [TR] You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
achievement.440.name: Buried the Baron
achievement.441.description: [TR] The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
achievement.441.name: [TR] Death in the Depths
achievement.442.description: [TR] You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
achievement.442.name: Scourge of Scarabs
achievement.443.description: [TR] Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
achievement.443.name: Cobbled and Patched
achievement.444.description: [TR] Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
achievement.444.name: Up the Molehill
achievement.445.description: [TR] You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
achievement.445.name: Master Debater
achievement.446.description: [TR] You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
achievement.446.name: High and Dry
achievement.447.description: [TR] Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
achievement.447.name: Elven Woods
achievement.448.description: [TR] Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
achievement.448.name: [TR] Long Live the Queen
achievement.449.description: [TR] Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
achievement.449.name: Stronghold of Edron
achievement.450.description: [TR] Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.450.name: Dwarven Mines
achievement.451.description: [TR] Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
achievement.451.name: [TR] All Hail the King
achievement.452.description: [TR] Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.452.name: [TR] Jewel in the Swamp
achievement.453.description: [TR] A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
achievement.453.name: The Ogre Steppe
achievement.454.description: [TR] Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
achievement.454.name: Realms of Dreams
achievement.455.description: [TR] You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
achievement.455.name: Mummy's Dearest
achievement.456.description: [TR] You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
achievement.456.name: Daraman's Footsteps
achievement.457.description: [TR] You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
achievement.457.name: [TR] King of the Jungle
achievement.458.description: [TR] You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
achievement.458.name: Ancient Splendor
achievement.459.description: [TR] A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
achievement.459.name: Liberty Bay Watch
achievement.460.description: [TR] You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
achievement.460.name: [TR] Race to the Pole
achievement.461.description: [TR] From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
achievement.461.name: Lizard Kingdom
achievement.462.description: [TR] Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
achievement.462.name: [TR] Trip to the Beach
achievement.463.description: [TR] Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
achievement.463.name: Glooth Punk
achievement.464.description: [TR] A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
achievement.464.name: Twisted Dreams
achievement.465.description: [TR] Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
achievement.465.name: Library Liberator
achievement.466.description: [TR] You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
achievement.466.name: Spectulation
achievement.467.description: [TR] You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
achievement.467.name: Millennial Falcon
achievement.468.description: [TR] You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
achievement.468.name: Bibliomaniac
achievement.469.description: [TR] Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
achievement.469.name: Battle Mage
achievement.470.description: [TR] As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
achievement.470.name: Widely Travelled
achievement.471.description: [TR] You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
achievement.471.name: Running the Rift
achievement.473.description: [TR] Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
achievement.473.name: Exalted Battle Mage
achievement.474.description: [TR] Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
achievement.474.name: Areas of Effect
achievement.475.description: [TR] You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
achievement.475.name: Tied the Knot
achievement.476.description: [TR] You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
achievement.476.name: [TR] Keeper of the 7 Keys
achievement.477.description: [TR] You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
achievement.477.name: Dream Warrior
achievement.478.description: [TR] Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
achievement.478.name: Moth Whisperer
achievement.479.description: [TR] You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
achievement.479.name: Lacewing Catcher
achievement.480.description: [TR] This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
achievement.480.name: [TR] No Horse Open Sleigh
achievement.481.description: [TR] But can you truly be one of them?
achievement.481.name: [TR] Raider in the Dark
achievement.482.description: [TR] You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
achievement.482.name: Dream Catcher
achievement.483.description: [TR] You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
achievement.483.name: Champion of Summer
achievement.484.description: [TR] You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
achievement.484.name: Champion of Winter
achievement.486.description: [TR] You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
achievement.486.name: Bewitcher
achievement.487.description: [TR] Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
achievement.487.name: Gryphon Rider
achievement.488.description: [TR] Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
achievement.488.name: Sculptor Apprentice
achievement.489.description: [TR] You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
achievement.489.name: Sun and Sea
achievement.490.description: [TR] You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
achievement.490.name: [TR] A Study in Scarlett
achievement.491.description: [TR] What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
achievement.491.name: Avid Spectral Reader
achievement.492.description: [TR] You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
achievement.492.name: Hippofoddermus
achievement.493.description: [TR] You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
achievement.493.name: Inquisition's Hand
achievement.494.description: [TR] Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
achievement.494.name: The Empire's Glory
achievement.495.description: [TR] Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated Hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
achievement.495.name: Inquisition's Arm
achievement.496.description: [TR] You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
achievement.496.name: Traditionalist
achievement.497.description: [TR] Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
achievement.497.name: [TR] Do a Barrel Roll!
achievement.499.description: [TR] The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
achievement.499.name: Orcsoberfest Welcome
achievement.500.description: [TR] You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
achievement.500.name: Prospectre
achievement.501.description: [TR] You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
achievement.501.name: Nothing but Hot Air
achievement.502.name: Verminbane
achievement.503.description: [TR] Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
achievement.503.name: Monsterhunter
achievement.504.description: [TR] Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
achievement.504.name: Taskmaster
achievement.505.description: [TR] Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
achievement.505.name: Mainstreet Nightmare
achievement.506.description: [TR] A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
achievement.506.name: Falconer
achievement.507.description: [TR] Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
achievement.507.name: Steppe Elegance
achievement.508.description: [TR] Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
achievement.508.name: Beyonder
achievement.510.description: [TR] If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
achievement.510.name: Drama in Darama
achievement.511.description: [TR] Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
achievement.511.name: Malefitz
achievement.512.description: [TR] You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
achievement.512.name: Lionheart
achievement.513.description: [TR] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.513.name: Soul Mender
achievement.514.description: [TR] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.514.name: [TR] You Got Horse Power
achievement.515.description: [TR] You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
achievement.515.name: Unleash the Beast
achievement.516.description: [TR] You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
achievement.516.name: Well Roared, Lion!
achievement.518.description: [TR] When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
achievement.518.name: Honorary Rascoohan
achievement.519.description: [TR] Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
achievement.519.name: Release the Kraken
achievement.521.description: [TR] You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
achievement.521.name: Pied Piper
achievement.522.description: [TR] You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
achievement.522.name: Woodcarver
achievement.523.description: [TR] Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
achievement.523.name: Bounacean Chivalry
achievement.524.description: [TR] Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
achievement.524.name: Knowledge Raider
achievement.525.description: [TR] It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
achievement.525.name: Citizen of Issavi
achievement.526.description: [TR] Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
achievement.526.name: King's Council
achievement.527.description: [TR] Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
achievement.527.name: [TR] Hot on the Trail
achievement.528.description: [TR] Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
achievement.528.name: [TR] Shell We Take a Ride
achievement.529.description: [TR] This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
achievement.529.name: Phantastic!
achievement.530.description: [TR] You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
achievement.530.name: [TR] Some Like It Hot
achievement.531.description: [TR] Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
achievement.531.name: First Achievement
achievement.532.description: [TR] Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
achievement.532.name: Sharp Dressed
achievement.533.description: [TR] This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
achievement.533.name: Engine Driver
achievement.534.description: [TR] You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
achievement.534.name: Friendly Fire
achievement.535.description: [TR] Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
achievement.535.name: Wedding Planner
achievement.536.description: [TR] You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
achievement.536.name: Beaver Away
achievement.537.description: [TR] Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
achievement.537.name: Snake Pit
achievement.538.description: [TR] For some it can't be hazardous enough.
achievement.538.name: Royalty of Hazard
achievement.539.description: [TR] Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
achievement.539.name: Measuring the World
achievement.540.description: [TR] Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.
achievement.540.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!
achievement.541.description: [TR] Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
achievement.541.name: [TR] Warrior of the Iks
achievement.542.description: [TR] You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
achievement.542.name: Mutagenius
achievement.543.description: [TR] Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
achievement.543.name: Strangest Thing
achievement.544.description: [TR] You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
achievement.544.name: Fully Decayed
achievement.545.description: [TR] Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
achievement.545.name: [TR] Like Fox and Mouse
achievement.546.description: [TR] Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
achievement.546.name: [TR] The Spirit of Purity
achievement.547.description: [TR] You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
achievement.547.name: Museum Goer
achievement.548.description: [TR] Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
achievement.548.name: Mystic Predator
achievement.549.description: [TR] You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
achievement.549.name: [TR] The Rule of Raccool
